title: Regression suite to prevent quality regressions
description: Added regression script that validates similarity/wer/click metrics against thresholds.

title: Benchmark Vevo local inference on M3 Max
description: Measure Vevo vevotimbre/vevovoice streaming window inference time on macOS (MPS vs CPU) and decide if fully local live VC is feasible.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Bench (M3 Max, torch mps): vevotimbre win=1000 hop=500 steps=8 mean=0.521s (rtf=1.04, borderline slow); steps=6 mean=0.395s (rtf=0.79, realtime). vevotimbre win=600 hop=600 steps=8 mean=0.495s (rtf=0.83, realtime). CPU win=1000 hop=500 steps=8 mean=5.29s (rtf=10.6). vevovoice mps win=1000 hop=1000 steps=8 mean=2.59s (rtf=2.59, not realtime).

title: Strengthen live VC eval + auto-tune best macOS streaming config
description: Add deterministic playlist builder and strengthen search/regress gates (WER/rtf_p95) to find best window/hop/steps on M3 Max.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Added deterministic playlist builder (evaluation/vevo_live/build_playlist.py) + two-stage macOS tuner (evaluation/vevo_live/tune_macos.py), fixed search.py fade-grid bug, and established new stable macOS presets (steps4 2000w/2000h and 1500w/1500h) validated by regress on a deterministic GLOBE playlist.

title: Vevo live: polish client/server UX
description: Add clearer CLI docs for port forwarding and audio device selection; consider server-side backpressure/queue and optional limiter/AGC smoothing.

title: Add local live VC runner (Mac/MPS)
description: Provide a single-process live buffered VC script (mic -> Vevo on MPS -> playback) to avoid websocket/server RTT and make macOS usage simple.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Implemented single-process local live VC runner (mic -> Vevo -> playback) at models/vc/vevo/live_local.py and documented usage in models/vc/vevo/README.md.

title: Live buffered Vevo conversion: mic -> buffer -> inference -> playback
description: Implemented buffered live pipeline via websocket server (GPU) + local client (mic/playback) with window/hop buffering, length normalization, and boundary crossfades.

title: Live Vevo quality tuning + DSP polish
description: Tune window/hop/crossfade and add light DSP (HPF/DC, limiter/softclip, VAD smoothing) to reduce glitches; validate with evaluation/vevo_live search + regress thresholds.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Improved live stability by replacing tail-mix crossfade with boundary smoothing; updated evaluation/vevo_live/best_configs/vevotimbre.json (fade=10) and tuned regress defaults for VC.

title: Make stylestream_like dataset closer to StyleStream-Test
description: Extend build_manifest to include LibriTTS test-clean sources and L2-ARCTIC accent targets (and keep RAVDESS emotion targets), with fixed revisions + deterministic sampling, so metrics are more directly comparable to the StyleStream paper.
notes: Implement StyleStream-Test-like manifest preset (LibriTTS-test-clean + GLOBE + RAVDESS + L2-ARCTIC) for paper-comparable metrics.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Implemented LibriTTS test-clean sources via HF dataset mythicinfinity/libritts; stylestream_test preset now uses 50% GLOBE + 50% LibriTTS and records libritts_revision in manifest meta.

title: Fix live_local streaming noise (window/hop) + deterministic quality gate
description: Live local sim outputs are noisy with 600-1000ms windows. Update streaming config search/presets to use >=1500ms windows, enforce realtime constraint, and add regression gate (WER/content) to catch noise.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Fixed live_local noise by moving streaming defaults/presets to window=2000ms hop=1000ms; search now sweeps window_ms + enforces rtf<=1 + constant eval_seconds; regress tightened max_wer default to 0.9. Commit: 0a8d19b.

title: Paper-comparable eval vs StyleStream (WER/S-SIM/A-SIM/E-SIM)
description: Add an evaluation mode that matches StyleStream paper objective metrics: Whisper-large-v3 WER vs transcript, Resemblyzer speaker similarity, accent similarity via Jzuluaga accent-id ecapa, emotion similarity via emotion2vec, plus deterministic StyleStream-like dataset subset + report.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Patched Vast scripts to override HF cache vars (HF_HOME/HF_DATASETS_CACHE/TRANSFORMERS_CACHE) to /root/.cache/huggingface so eval downloads stop filling /workspace. Next: rerun stylestream_like smoke + full eval on Vast and record baseline report.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Vast fixes: HF cache moved off /workspace; pinned datasets<3 + added addict/simplejson/sortedcontainers for modelscope emotion2vec; pinned ruamel.yaml<0.19. Smoke stylestream_like eval works with USE_EMOTION=1. Ran vevotimbre eval (NUM_SOURCES=30, PAIRS_PER_SOURCE=10, FLOW_STEPS=16, Whisper large-v3): mean WER=0.0449, S-SIM=0.7727, A-SIM=0.4015, E-SIM=0.9528 (300 pairs) under runs/stylestream_like_30src.

title: Vevo live: improve eval efficiency + content metric
description: Cache speaker/ASR models during search, avoid per-config reloads, and improve content-preservation metric (Whisper WER robustness; consider language forcing/VAD/ASR confidence).

title: Deterministic evaluation harness + autotune for Vevo VC
description: Added deterministic streaming simulation + grid search autotune harness and best-config artifact outputs.

title: Vevo wrapper: offline WAV->WAV conversion CLI
description: Add a standalone CLI entrypoint that runs Amphion's official Vevo inference to convert an input audio file (source) into the target speaker/style defined by a reference clip. Must support vevovoice and vevotimbre checkpoints/configs and write an output WAV deterministically.

title: Offline Vevo quality tuning via stylestream_like search
description: Add a deterministic search harness over Vevo offline parameters (flow steps, cfg/rescale; plus AR params for vevovoice) using evaluation/stylestream_like metrics, and save best configs + baseline reports for regression.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Re-ran Vast stylestream_test (LibriTTS) baselines and updated evaluation/stylestream_like/best_configs + *.metrics.json; also silenced noisy Whisper/emotion2vec logging for deterministic runs.

title: Fix live online noise/dropouts
description: Online (streaming) Vevo outputs have random noise and hop-to-hop cuts/jumps; offline is clean. Likely per-window loudness normalization and/or stitching.
acceptance_criteria: Online simulated outputs (live_local) no longer exhibit gain pumping/noise bursts or audible dropouts compared to offline; regression metrics catch these artifacts.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Fix: removed per-window RMS normalization; added VAD gating + peak limiter to live_local/live_server/live_client + simulate_streaming; added artifact metrics + gates (silence leakage/dropouts/clipping) to search/regress. Commit: 123bedc.

title: Generate user sample offline/online conversions
description: Use v5.wav and fr_voice_female_sample as src/ref (both directions), run on RTX 4090 and copy 4 outputs back to mac for listening.
close_reason: Generated offline+online outputs on RTX 4090 and copied to mac

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Generated 4 listening artifacts on Vast RTX 4090 and copied to local mac: runs/vevo_live/user_pair/{fr_to_v5_offline.wav, fr_to_v5_online.wav, v5_to_fr_offline.wav, v5_to_fr_online.wav}. Offline: models.vc.vevo.convert (vevotimbre, steps=32). Online: models.vc.vevo.live_local file sim using runs/vevo_live/tune_gpu_4090/best_score_config.json (steps=6, window=2000, hop=500, fade=10).

title: Vast.ai workflow: git sync + run scripts for inference/eval
description: Added scripts/vast/* for venv setup, git pull, offline smoke, live server, and autotune on RTX 4090 host.
